item.title: Nicko McBrain Fires Back at IRON MAIDEN’s New Drummer, Declares ‘He’s Not Me’ and Says Band Can’t Replace 42 Years of History
item.description: Former Iron Maiden drummer Nicko McBrain is enjoying life after retirement, but he’s still got a few things to say, especially about the band he spent over four decades performing with.
